4f31d6b513311c71.description: About the Role Halian is seeking a Senior Data Engineer – BigQuery (GCP/SAP Data) for a contract position in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. This role supports a significant enterprise cloud data transformation project focused on migrating critical Finance and HR reporting workloads from SAP BW on HANA to Google BigQuery. The successful candidate will manage the data engineering layer, ensuring data quality, performance, and security. Role Context and Objectives The Senior Data Engineer will take ownership of various aspects of the data engineering layer, including SAP S/4HANA ingestion, migration of SAP BW transformation logic, BigQuery data modelling, and pipeline orchestration. The role also involves implementing robust security measures, optimizing performance, and ensuring data reconciliation. A key objective is to support the creation of high-quality, AI-ready datasets for advanced analytics, conversational analytics, and predictive use cases. Key Responsibilities Analyze existing SAP BW data flows, including DataSources, DSOs, InfoCubes, transformations, ABAP routines, and APDs, and rebuild the required transformation logic using BigQuery SQL. Ingest and integrate data from SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and/or SAP BW into Google Cloud-based data platforms. Design scalable BigQuery data models utilizing raw, curated, and reporting layers. Build complex data structures, including hierarchies, time-dependent master data, dimensional models, and star schemas. Develop, orchestrate, and monitor data pipelines using Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, including automated alerting for pipeline and load failures. Implement data security within BigQuery, including row-level security (RLS), column-level security (CLS), authorized views, role-based access, and PII masking. Optimize BigQuery workloads for performance and cost using partitioning, clustering, query optimization, and efficient data modelling. Build automated data-quality controls and reconciliation processes to validate migrated datasets against existing SAP BW reporting. Produce and maintain data lineage, transformation documentation, and source-to-target mappings. Prepare governed AI-ready datasets for conversational analytics, predictive use cases, and downstream AI applications. Support downstream reporting and analytics solutions developed using Looker or custom web applications. Collaborate with business, Finance, HR, SAP, cloud, analytics, and reporting teams to validate business logic and data accuracy. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on cloud data transformation projects. Expertise in SAP data environments and Google BigQuery is essential for this role. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. The role involves working closely with various internal teams, including business stakeholders, Finance, HR, SAP, cloud, analytics, and reporting teams, to ensure successful project delivery and data integrity.

4f055b11234fa5f1.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطط العلاج، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تركيبات الأسنان ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية المطلوبة وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطة علاجية متكاملة مع برنامجها الزمني. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير العمل والتوثيق المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء أداء جميع مهام طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية الصحية اللازمة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الاسنان بمدينة تبوك. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة.

4f1ba6db7ac06891.description: About the Role The Public Investment Fund (PIF) is seeking a Portfolio Strategy and Asset Allocation Professional to join its International Investments team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing to the development, implementation, and ongoing oversight of strategic asset allocation frameworks and diversified multi-asset portfolios. The professional will support long-term portfolio construction aligned with investment objectives and policy statements. Key Responsibilities Support the development, review, and implementation of Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) frameworks in alignment with long-term objectives, risk tolerance, and Investment Policy Statement (IPS) constraints. Contribute to the development and periodic review of capital market assumptions, including expected returns, volatility, and correlations across various asset classes. Support the development and review of investment policy statements, policy benchmarks, allocation ranges, and rebalancing frameworks. Collaborate with the Portfolio Performance and Analytics team to monitor portfolio performance, attribution, and risk exposures against approved benchmarks and investment policy requirements. Assess portfolio exposure across asset classes, geographies, sectors, currencies, and other investment factors, including concentration and liquidity risks. Support approved allocation changes and portfolio rebalancing by coordinating with external manager selection teams and other relevant PIF departments. Prepare presentations and updates pertaining to International Public Investments proposals and performance for PIF Committees and Executive Management. Contribute to the preparation of internal update reports and required updates for the PIF Board and related committees and/or other entities. Operational Accountabilities Implement operational excellence improvement initiatives and propose enhancements to systems, processes, and practices, considering international leading practices to continuously improve organizational effectiveness and business performance. 4fbc37cc181f333e.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This role involves leading the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. The Product Manager will manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities, from customer research and data modeling to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. The position requires collaboration with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem that supports self-service analytics, compliance, and executive decision-making. The Product Manager will also lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Act as an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design. Collect business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Develop detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Understand schema design and its impact on performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning of new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing capabilities to help others grow. Resilience to manage pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Focus on quality and attention to detail, striving for improvement. Advocacy for best practices, efficiency, and innovation. Work Environment The Engineering team at Unifonic is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. The team collaborates with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. This role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position.

4f2fc3847147c430.description: The UI/UX Specialist is responsible for shaping, designing, and continuously improving user experiences across KAUST’s IT services and touch points. The role ensures that all interfaces and journeys adopt industry-leading user-centric design principles, accessibility standards, and align with the IT Department’s UI/UX framework. A key responsibility of this role is to establish, document, and communicate clear UI/UX processes and standards to stakeholders, ensuring consistent adoption across teams and projects. The specialist partners with service owners and user engagement specialists to conduct user research, develop prototypes, perform usability testing, and provide design governance. Through this work, the UI/UX Specialist enables the delivery of intuitive, efficient, and accessible digital experiences that support KAUST’s goals of operational excellence, technology enablement, and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities: Work with team members to define and maintain UI/UX principles, guidelines, and best practices for IT services. Review interfaces and service designs for alignment with established UX guidelines and provide feedback for improvement. Define and maintain UI/UX principles, guidelines, and best practices for IT services. Conduct user research (interviews, surveys, observations) to identify needs and pain points. Translate research insights into personas, journey maps, task flows, and actionable recommendations. Design intuitive, accessible interfaces, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction flows. Conduct usability testing and validate solutions through iterative feedback cycles. Collaborate with IT service owners, developers, and business analysts to ensure user-centered design. Ensure all designs comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.2), branding guidelines, and design systems. Provide feedback on interfaces, service designs, and design assets to maintain quality and consistency. Advocate for users, ensuring inclusivity, fairness, and accessibility in all design decisions. Facilitate workshops, co-design sessions, and collaborative design discussions with stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in HCI, Information Systems, Graphic Design, or related field. 5+ years of experience in UI/UX design, user research, or usability evaluation. Strong knowledge of human-centered design principles, usability heuristics, and accessibility standards. Proficiency with modern design/prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent. Solid understanding of responsive design, interaction design, design systems, and user research methods. Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end UX activities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills. Attention to detail with a focus on producing high-quality, consistent, and accessible designs. Preferred: Experience in higher education or IT service environments, contributing to design systems or institutional branding. Preferred Certifications: NN/g UX Certification, IDEO U Design Thinking, CUA, CXA, or similar credentials.
